snippet.title: Tera Mera Rishta Continues (Film Ballad)| Awarapan 2| Emraan, Disha| Mithoon, Saaj, Sayeed, Mustafa
snippet.description:
Zakhmi parinda hai.. 
Phir bhi tu zinda hai.. 
Maanle kehna mera..❤️ 

Tune into ‘Tera Mera Rishta Continues (Film Ballad) from ‘Awarapan 2’. A heartfelt melody about love, hope, and never giving up, this beautiful track is recreated and rearranged by Mithoon. With lyrics by Sayeed Quadri and vocals by Saaj Bhatt and Subodhh Sharma, the original song is composed by Mustafa Zahid with music by Pritam. It features Emraan Hashmi and Disha Patani in the video.
 
#TereMeraRishtaContinues #Awarapan2 #EmraanHashmi #DishaPatani #Mustafazahid  #Mithoon #SaajBhatt #SayeedQuadri #SubodhhSharma 
 
Music recreated & rearranged by Mithoon
Lyrics: Sayeed Quadri
Singers: Saaj Bhatt, Subodhh Sharma
Original Song Composer - Mustafa Zahid
Original Song Music - Pritam

Creative Head: Anugrah
Music Production : Godswill Mergulhão
Music Assistants: Anugrah, Godswill Mergulhão, Eli Rodrigues & Kaushal Gohil.

Flute: Rakesh Chaurasia
Guitars: Kalyan Baruah
World Strokes - Chintoo Singh
Dholak & Tabla: Satyajit Jamsandekar, Rahul Rupawate, Arun Mohite & Sandesh Kadam.

Backing Vocals: Abhishek Nailwal, Godswill Mergulhão, Mihir Sharma & Kaustubh More, Amrita Talukder & Damini Gautam

Recorded at YRF studios by Vijay Dayal
Assistant Engineer - Sagar Sathe
Recorded at Livingwater Music by A Manivannan

Mixed and Mastered by Eric Pillai at Future sound of Bombay
Assistant Mixing Engineer - Michael Edwin Pillai

Project Head (Team Mithoon) - Vijay Iyer

snippet.title: Dorothy (Tamil) | Official Title Teaser | Karthik Subbaraj | Keerthy Suresh
snippet.description:
Jio Studios and Sikhya Entertainment present a Sikhya Entertainment and Dhammam Films Production.

Presenting the Official Title Teaser of Dorothy, writer-director Karthik Subbaraj's landmark 10th feature, featuring an original score by Maestro in his milestone 1,540th film.

Dorothy will have its World Premiere at the 2026 Toronto International Film Festival (TIFF) in the Centrepiece section, becoming the first Indian Tamil film in a decade to be selected at the festival.

1976 ലെ പകർപ്പവകാശ നിയമത്തിലെ സെക്ഷൻ 107 പ്രകാരം, വിമർശനം, അഭിപ്രായം, വാർത്താ റിപ്പോർട്ടിംഗ്, അധ്യാപനം, സ്കോളർഷിപ്പ്, വിദ്യാഭ്യാസം, ഗവേഷണം തുടങ്ങിയ ആവശ്യങ്ങൾക്കായി "ന്യായമായ ഉപയോഗത്തിന്" അനുവാദം നൽകിയിട്ടുണ്ട്. ... ലാഭേച്ഛയില്ലാത്ത, വിദ്യാഭ്യാസപരമോ വ്യക്തിഗതമോ ആയ ഉപയോഗം ന്യായമായ ഉപയോഗത്തിന് അനുകൂലമായി ബാലൻസ് നൽകുന്നു.

ക്രെഡിറ്റുകൾ/നീക്കം ചെയ്യൽ അഭ്യർത്ഥനകൾ നഷ്ടപ്പെട്ടാൽ ദയവായി എനിക്ക് ഇമെയിൽ ചെയ്യുക. നന്ദി

పాట్రియన్‌లో నా పూర్తి సినిమా రియాక్షన్‌లను చూడండి

www.patreon.com/teacherpaulreacts

నమస్కారం మిత్రులారా! నా పేరు పాల్. నేను 6 సంవత్సరాలు టీవీ మరియు ఫిల్మ్ పరిశ్రమలో పనిచేశాను, ఇప్పుడు నేను భాషా ఉపాధ్యాయుడిని మరియు నాకు సినిమాలు అంటే చాలా ఇష్టం!

కాపీరైట్ చట్టం 1976లోని సెక్షన్ 107 ప్రకారం, విమర్శ, వ్యాఖ్య, వార్తా నివేదన, బోధన, పాండిత్యం, విద్య మరియు పరిశోధన వంటి ప్రయోజనాల కోసం "న్యాయమైన ఉపయోగం" అనుమతించబడుతుంది. ... లాభాపేక్ష లేని, విద్యా సంబంధమైన లేదా వ్యక్తిగత ఉపయోగం న్యాయమైన ఉపయోగం వైపు మొగ్గు చూపుతుంది.

క్రెడిట్‌లు లేకపోవడం/తొలగింపు అభ్యర్థనల విషయంలో దయచేసి నాకు ఇ-మెయిల్ చేయండి. ధన్యవాదాలు

స్పాన్సర్‌షిప్‌లు మరియు వ్యాపారం కోసం: teacherpaulreacts@gmail.com

pa.description:
ਰਾਮਾਇਣ | ਅਧਿਕਾਰਤ ਟ੍ਰੇਲਰ (ਅੰਗਰੇਜ਼ੀ)
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=le2W_fB_4KY
ਪੈਟਰੀਓਨ 'ਤੇ ਮੇਰੀ ਪੂਰੀ ਫਿਲਮ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਕਿਰਿਆਵਾਂ ਦੇਖੋ
www.patreon.com/teacherpaulreacts
ਡਿਸਕੌਰਡ 'ਤੇ ਮੇਰੇ ਨਾਲ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਹੋਵੋ: https://discord.gg/ebYMwXRfWg
ਇੱਥੇ ਇੱਕ ਵੀਡੀਓ ਦੀ ਬੇਨਤੀ ਕਰੋ: https://buymeacoffee.com/teacherpaul

ਹੈਲੋ ਦੋਸਤੋ! ਮੈਂ ਪੌਲ ਹਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਮੈਂ ਟੀਵੀ ਅਤੇ ਫਿਲਮ ਉਦਯੋਗ ਵਿੱਚ 6 ਸਾਲਾਂ ਤੋਂ ਕੰਮ ਕੀਤਾ ਹੈ, ਹੁਣ ਮੈਂ ਇੱਕ ਭਾਸ਼ਾ ਅਧਿਆਪਕ ਹਾਂ ਅਤੇ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਫਿਲਮਾਂ ਪਸੰਦ ਹਨ!

ਕਾਪੀਰਾਈਟ ਐਕਟ 1976 ਦੀ ਧਾਰਾ 107 ਦੇ ਤਹਿਤ ਕਾਪੀਰਾਈਟ ਬੇਦਾਅਵਾ, ਆਲੋਚਨਾ, ਟਿੱਪਣੀ, ਖ਼ਬਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਰਿਪੋਰਟਿੰਗ, ਸਿੱਖਿਆ, ਸਕਾਲਰਸ਼ਿਪ, ਸਿੱਖਿਆ ਅਤੇ ਖੋਜ ਵਰਗੇ ਉਦੇਸ਼ਾਂ ਲਈ "ਨਿਰਪੱਖ ਵਰਤੋਂ" ਲਈ ਭੱਤਾ ਦਿੱਤਾ ਜਾਂਦਾ ਹੈ। ... ਗੈਰ-ਮੁਨਾਫ਼ਾ, ਵਿਦਿਅਕ ਜਾਂ ਨਿੱਜੀ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਨਿਰਪੱਖ ਵਰਤੋਂ ਦੇ ਹੱਕ ਵਿੱਚ ਸੰਤੁਲਨ ਨੂੰ ਸੁਝਾਅ ਦਿੰਦੀ ਹੈ।

ਗੁੰਮ ਹੋਏ ਕ੍ਰੈਡਿਟ/ਹਟਾਉਣ ਦੀਆਂ ਬੇਨਤੀਆਂ ਦੇ ਮਾਮਲੇ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਕਰਕੇ ਮੈਨੂੰ ਈਮੇਲ ਕਰੋ। ਧੰਨਵਾਦ

snippet.description:
यह वीडियो एवं इसमें प्रस्तुत सभी पात्र और घटनाएँ केवल मनोरंजन (Entertainment Purpose) के उद्देश्य से बनाई गई हैं। वीडियो में बच्चों सहित सभी पात्रों का उपयोग केवल कहानी और रचनात्मक प्रस्तुति के संदर्भ में किया गया है।

इस वीडियो का उद्देश्य किसी भी धर्म, जाति, समुदाय, व्यक्ति या धार्मिक भावनाओं को ठेस पहुँचाना नहीं है। यदि किसी दृश्य, संवाद या प्रस्तुति से किसी की भावनाएँ आहत होती हैं, तो यह पूर्णतः अनजाने में है और हमारा उद्देश्य किसी का अपमान करना नहीं है।

यह वीडियो केवल मनोरंजन के लिए है। कृपया इसे मनोरंजन के रूप में ही देखें।


Singer : Armaan Malik & Ruchika Jangid
Director : Amaan Malik
Staring : Armaan Malik, Payal Malik, Kritika Malik, Chirayu, Navya, Zaid, Ayaan, Tuba

snippet.description:
Aadi Krithigai Special Murugan Songs 2026

Celebrate the divine blessings of Lord Murugan on the auspicious occasion of Aadi Krithigai with this powerful collection of Tamil devotional songs. These soul-stirring Murugan songs invoke courage, wisdom, prosperity, and divine grace.

Whether you are observing Aadi Krithigai Viratham, visiting Murugan temples, performing pooja, or simply seeking spiritual peace, this devotional playlist fills your day with Murugan's blessings.

Listen to timeless Tamil Murugan songs praising the glory of Arupadai Veedu Murugan, Vel Murugan, Palani Murugan, Thiruchendur Murugan, Thirupparankundram Murugan, Swamimalai Murugan, Pazhamudircholai Murugan, and Thiruthani Murugan.

🔹 Attracts wealth, prosperity, and abundance 💰
🔹 Removes financial obstacles and negativity ❌
🔹 Brings peace, success, and happiness 🌼
🔹 Blesses devotees with fortune and positive energy ✨

🎶 These powerful songs are perfect for Friday Lakshmi Pooja, daily prayers, meditation, and spiritual growth. Worship Goddess Lakshmi with devotion and receive divine grace.

🙏 Om Shree Mahalakshmi Namaha
🌸 Jai Mahalakshmi Devi 🌸

snippet.title: INSIDIOUS: OUT OF THE FURTHER - Final Trailer (4K)
snippet.description:
Evil found a way out. 

The final trailer has come for our world. GET TICKETS NOW. #Insidious: Out Of The Further is exclusively in theatres August 21." 

Follow us on social: 
https://www.instagram.com/InsidiousMovie   
https://twitter.com/InsidiousMovie  
https://www.facebook.com/InsidiousMovie  
https://www.tiktok.com/@insidious.movie

Visit our site: https://insidious.movie 
Subscribe for more exclusive content: https://www.youtube.com/sonypictures 

Having earned over $740 million at the global box office, the Insidious franchise returns with a new family and a terror that redefines what The Further is capable of.
 
In Insidious: Out of the Further, Amelia Eve stars as Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in who discovers she can travel into The Further, the purgatorial realm of lost souls at the heart of the Insidious universe. When something evil comes after her, Gemma discovers an ability that changes everything: she doesn’t just enter The Further, she can bring what lives there back to the real world. Once the demons realize her power, our world becomes their playground.
 
With Lin Shaye reprising her iconic role as Elise Rainier and Jacob Chase (Come Play) directing, Insidious: Out of the Further opens August 21, 2026. Screenplay by Jacob Chase. Story by David Leslie Johnson-McGoldrick and Jacob Chase.

snippet.description:
Presenting The KENDADOKULI GANDAANA Video Song from the Movie #CITYLIGHTS  Starring : Vinay Rajkumar, Monisha Vijaykumar & Others Exclusive Only On Anand Audio Official Youtube Channel..!!! 
------------------------------------------------------------- 
#CITYLIGHTS #KENDADOKULIGANDAANA #duniyavijaykumar #Kamsaledhanush #madeshwara  #citylightsmovie #vinayrajkumar #kandammakandamma #bavabava #sanjithhegde #anilkumar #anandaudio #charanraj  #monishavijaykumar  #youtube #nagarjunasharma  
-------------------------------------------------------------- 
Lyrics: 
Ughe Mahathmalaya.. Ughe.
Hattarugavada Ettarugavda
Sutta Hanneredu Gavada
Aane tale dimbinda haari
Sthala olledu Jaaga olledu anta heli
Yeppatthelu male kailasadalli
Odedu moodiruvantha muddu madappana
Paadakke Ughe yenni.
Ughe.
Aanumale aaskondu Jenumale hothkondu
Mikkohog myagmale mele marthu malagirovantha
Muddulu mukhada muddu madappana
Padakke Ondsari Ughe Yenni.
Ughe.
Ughe Mahathmalaya..
Ughe Mahathmalaya..
Ughe Mahathmalaya..
Ughe Mahathmalaya..
Kendadokuli gandaana Kandariyo dundu maadevana..
Kendadokuli gandaana Kandariyo dundu maadevana.. (Chorus)
Satyavanthege olidavanallo Kandariyo dundu maadevana..
Kendadokuli gandaana Kandariyo dundu maadevana.. (Chorus)
Nagakatta kattavanallo Kandariyo dundu maadevana..
Kendadokuli gandaana Kandariyo dundu maadevana.. (Chorus)
Rudra Ba Veerabhadra Baaro Kandariyo dundu maadevana..
Kendadokuli gandaana Kandariyo dundu maadevana.. (Chorus)
We have had our both hands in a prayer
For your arrival when we almost gave up
Burning fire in your eyes a rager
Witnessing your fury come alive Deva
Rejoice in your fury, sky has turned red
We celebrating your ruthless conquest
Give them no rest, evil's no match to your best
Catapult devils - fly off of the edge
Shower flowers, unleash your power
We bow down to our fierce deity savior
You're at the helm, protector of realms,
Vanquish the evil eternally.
Deva Deva Deva Deva Deva Deva Deva Deva Deva.
Kenda andare kuniyutha banda Kandariyo dundu maadevana..
Kendadokuli gandaana Kandariyo dundu maadevana.. (Chorus)
Aalambaadi hogavanallo Kandariyo dundu maadevana..
Kendadokuli gandaana Kandariyo dundu maadevana.. (Chorus)
Ughe Mahathmalaya.. Ughe.
….. aa devare deva
….. Maadevare deva
….. aa devare deva
….. Maadevare deva

#শিল্পী = গুরপ্রীত কৌর

শ্রদ্ধেয় শ্রোতাবৃন্দ,

গুরপ্রীত কৌরের পক্ষ থেকে সবাইকে রাম রাম।

আপনারা আমার হরিয়ানভি লোকগীতিগুলোকে অনেক ভালোবাসা দিয়েছেন এবং সেগুলোকে একটি অনন্য পরিচয় দিয়েছেন। এর জন্য আপনাদের সবাইকে আমার আন্তরিক ধন্যবাদ।

আর এখন আমি (গুরপ্রীত কৌর ভ্লগ) নামে আমার নিজের একটি ইউটিউব চ্যানেল খুলেছি।

সেখানে আপনারা আমার নতুন নতুন ভ্লগগুলোও দেখতে পাবেন। 🥰 আমার মা এবং পরিবারের সহযোগিতাতেই এই সবকিছু সম্ভব হয়েছে। ❤️ আমার স্বামী দীপক রেধুকে আমার আন্তরিক ধন্যবাদ ও স্যালুট, যিনি সবসময় ছায়ার মতো আমাকে সমর্থন করেছেন, সেই দয়ালু মানুষটি যিনি আমার পাশে থেকেছেন। তাকে ছাড়া আমি কিছুই না।

অনুগ্রহ করে আমার চ্যানেলটি খুঁজে নিন।

Sri Lalitha Sahasranamam | Lalita Devi Stotram For Protection & Prosperity

Experience the divine grace of Sri Lalitha Devi with the sacred Sri Lalitha Sahasranamam, one of the most powerful hymns dedicated to Sri Lalitha Tripura Sundari. Chanting or listening to the Lalitha Sahasranama with devotion is believed to bring protection, prosperity, inner peace, wisdom, and the blessings of the Divine Mother.

This devotional presentation includes Sri Lalitha Sahasranama Stotram with Lyrics, making it easy to follow and recite during your daily prayers, Fridays, Navaratri, and other auspicious occasions.

🌸 Includes:
Sri Lalitha Sahasranamam
Lalitha Sahasranama Stotram

🌺 Sacred Opening Lines

Sri Mata Sri Maharajni Sri Mat Simhasaneswari
Chidagnikunda Sambhuta Devakarya Samudyata

Udyad Bhanu Sahasrabha Chaturbahu Samanvita
Raga Swaroopa Pashadhya Krodhakarankushojwala

May the Divine Mother Sri Lalitha Tripura Sundari bless you and your family with health, happiness, prosperity, wisdom, success, and spiritual strength.

🙏 Om Aim Hreem Shreem Sri Matre Namah 🙏

snippet.title: Small Truck on Giant Funny Lamborghini with Giant Tire vs Giant Stairs, Portal Trap & Deep Water #9
snippet.description:
Watch an insane BeamNG.drive challenge where a **Small Transport Truck rides on top of a Giant Funny Lamborghini with a Giant Tire** while attempting to conquer massive stairs, dangerous portal traps, and deep water obstacles!

This hilarious and action-packed experiment pushes both vehicles to their absolute limits as they face impossible climbs, giant drops, teleporting portals, and unpredictable physics. Can the Small Truck stay balanced on the Giant Funny Lamborghini and survive every obstacle, or will one mistake send both vehicles crashing into deep water?

Prepare for nonstop action featuring spectacular crashes, realistic soft-body physics, huge jumps, impossible stair climbs, portal teleportation, and unbelievable vehicle destruction. Every obstacle becomes more challenging than the last, testing the balance, power, and stability of this crazy vehicle combination.
